item.title: High-Conductivity and Moisture-Tolerant Sulfide Electrolyte Enabled by Bifunctional Coating for Practical All-Solid-State Lithium Batteries
item.description:

Nano-Micro Letters | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 MPTMS bifunctional coating forms a ~10 nm hydrophobic barrier on LPSCBr sulfide electrolyte, cutting H₂S emission by 93% while retaining 83.1% ionic conductivity. This enables ambient-air processing of sulfide electrolytes without sacrificing performance, delivering 84.6% capacity retention over 1000 cycles in all-solid-state cells—advancing scalable, cost-effective ASSLB manufacturing.

item.title: Pristine Poly(3‐hexylthiophene) as an On‐Demand Conductive Binder and Redox Mediator for Carbon‐Additive‐Free, High‐Volumetric‐Energy‐Density, LiFePO 4 Cathodes without Calendaring
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 P3HT is introduced as a dual-function conductive binder and redox mediator for carbon-free LiFePO₄ cathodes, eliminating Super P and calendaring. It forms an internal percolating network via electrochemical doping, enabling 2.70 g cm⁻³ packing and 1402 Wh L⁻¹ volumetric energy density—far exceeding conventional SP:PVDF systems—while maintaining cycling stability and rate capability. This integrates conductivity, redox mediation, and interfacial stabilization for next-generation high-density LFP cathodes.

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers VN nanoparticles in lotus-root-like porous carbon nanofibers to synergistically coordinate Na nucleation thermodynamics and deposition kinetics. Electronic-structure engineering creates sodiophilic N/V sites lowering nucleation barriers, while hierarchical porosity homogenizes ion/electric fields. The result—dendrite-free cycling over 1000 h with 99.86% CE—establishes electronic-structure-induced sodiophilicity as a decisive design descriptor for stable alkali-metal anodes.

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a mesh-island confinement strategy using alternating atomic layer deposition to create ternary PtCoSn catalysts, with SnO-based mesh and support-confined islands stabilizing the alloy. Significance: achieves 1.46 W cm⁻² peak power and only 14.4% degradation after 30,000 cycles, offering a general route to durable fuel cell electrocatalysts.
